package myce

import("testing";"os";"path/filepath";"context";"encoding/json";"io/fs";"runtime")

func TestWriteReviewRCInstallation(t *testing.T){
 home:=os.Getenv("WP8_REVIEW_RC_HOME");src:=os.Getenv("WP8_REVIEW_RC_FIXTURE");binary:=os.Getenv("WP8_REVIEW_RC_BINARY")
 if home==""||src==""||binary==""{t.Fatal("isolated paths required")}
 d:=Detection{OS:"linux",Arch:runtime.GOARCH,Platform:"fake",MemoryMode:"fixed",MemoryGB:8}
 q,e:=PlanInstall("queue",home,"",home,"http://fixture-queue.invalid","fixture-queue",d);if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 q.EnvironmentFile=filepath.Join(home,"private-reference"); q.HostID="fixture-host";q.HostStateDir=filepath.Join(home,".local/share/myce")
 if e=os.WriteFile(q.EnvironmentFile,[]byte("MYCE_TOKEN=synthetic-fresh-install\nMYCE_QUEUE=http://fixture-queue.invalid\n"),0600);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 configs:=[]ServiceConfig{q}
 for i,name:=range []string{"gpu0","gpu1"}{w,e:=PlanInstall("worker",home,"",home,q.Queue,[]string{"fixture-worker","fixture-worker-two"}[i],d);if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};w.EnvironmentFile=q.EnvironmentFile; w.HostID=q.HostID;w.HostStateDir=q.HostStateDir;w.AllowDeviceless=true;if e=w.WorkerInstance(name);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};configs=append(configs,w)}
 for _,c:=range configs{if e=Install(context.Background(),c,binary,"test",func(context.Context,string,...string)([]byte,error){return nil,nil});e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}}
 copyFile:=func(from,to string)error{b,e:=os.ReadFile(from);if e!=nil{return e};if e=os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(to),0700);e!=nil{return e};return os.WriteFile(to,b,0600)}
 if e=copyFile(filepath.Join(src,"queue.db"),q.DB);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 for _,c:=range configs[1:]{
 if e=filepath.WalkDir(filepath.Join(src,"workers/one"),func(p string,d fs.DirEntry,e error)error{if e!=nil{return e};r,_:=filepath.Rel(filepath.Join(src,"workers/one"),p);to:=filepath.Join(c.State,r);if d.IsDir(){return os.MkdirAll(to,0700)};return copyFile(p,to)});e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 b,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(c.State,"state.json"));if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};var st workerState;if e=json.Unmarshal(b,&st);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 worker:=Worker{HostStateDir:c.HostStateDir,Machine:Machine{ID:c.Name,Session:st.Session,HostID:c.HostID},Client:Client{URL:c.Queue},ServiceConfig:c.Config,Unit:filepath.Base(c.Service),EnvironmentRoot:c.EnvironmentCache,ResumeCommand:[]string{c.Binary,"service","--config",c.Config}}
 if e=worker.registerHost(&workerStore{dir:c.State,state:st});e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 if e=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(c.State,"worker.lock"),nil,0600);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}
 }
 for _,s:=range []string{".lock",".uploads.lock"}{if e=os.WriteFile(q.DB+s,nil,0600);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}}
 t.Log("actual RC PlanInstall/Install/registerHost wrote queue and gpu0/gpu1")
}
